title.suggested: Tom Allen doubts report of St. Louis pugilist beaten in Idaho

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Tom Allen, shown a dispatch about a $1,000 prize fight at Caldwell, Idaho, between McFadden of Winnipeg and Martland of St. Louis, said he knew neither man and doubted the account. Tom Kelly agreed.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Thursday Morning, November 1, 1883.

notes: Allen's view is paraphrased, not quoted; no biography-level facts.
